data.title: Uber Sells Serve Robotics Stake, Catches Company Off Guard: ‘Differing Views’ Sour Partnership
data.description: Serve Robotics investors were already nursing loss after disappointing quarterly financial results. Another blow came days later when long0time Uber Technologies dumped its entire stake in the autonomous delivery robot company. According to a regulatory filing on Friday, Uber disclosed...
